Selected Work

Case Studies

A closer look at the creative angle, deliverables, and business value behind three recent collaborations.

Adventure UGC
GetYourGuide × iFly Orlando
Challenge: Make indoor skydiving feel exciting, approachable, and worth booking for a first-timer audience.
Angle: First-person arrival, gear-up moment, the flight, the reaction, and a natural booking CTA at the end.
Deliverables: TikTok, Instagram Reel, short-form UGC-style travel asset.
Value: Adventure content built from the real customer experience — not staged promotional footage.
Experience UGC
Fly Heli Tours
Challenge: Capture the feeling of a helicopter tour in a way that converts curiosity into bookings.
Angle: Boarding sequence, aerial perspective, the moment of awe, and the landing — told from a guest POV.
Deliverables: Short-form vertical video, organic social asset, booking funnel creative.
Value: Cinematic but natural — the kind of content that makes viewers feel like they are already there.
Cultural UGC
Razzouk Tattoo, Jerusalem
Challenge: Tell the story of one of the world's oldest tattoo shops in a way that feels modern without losing the heritage.
Angle: Arrival in the Old City, the shop atmosphere, the craft, and the personal experience — documentary-style but short-form.
Deliverables: TikTok storytelling video, cultural travel asset.
Value: Brand story told from a traveler's genuine perspective — 570K+ views.

About

About Malachi

I'm an Orlando native, travel creator, and former Division I athlete who creates content from the perspective brands actually want customers to imagine: arriving, experiencing, reacting, and wanting to book.

My work sits between polished travel media and real guest POV — which makes it usable without feeling staged. I've collaborated with GetYourGuide, Fly Heli Tours, Razzouk Tattoo Jerusalem, SeaQuest Milos, Norcineria Iacozzilli, Scorpion Diving, and iFly Indoor Skydiving.

I'm based in Orlando and available for on-location shoots across Florida, the US, and international destinations. All content is shot in 4K and delivered ready for organic social, paid usage, or your booking funnel.
